messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from postmortem: missing spans + bad aggregation + ETL lag. I pulled the postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1860127000. Need owners + remediation timelines. Who can take which action?
adrian: I can own the span-loss root cause investigation. I'll dig into the tracer -> envoy sampling drop. ETA EOD Thu.
sam: I'll take aggregation correctness — looks like a join issue in the agg pipeline, probably a coinflip between dedupe stage and windowing. Will put up a PR by Mon and add unit tests.
lee: ETL lag is my area. I can add backpressure insights and a retry/backoff change. Propose a rolling rollout next week, need SRE signoff.
tara: I'm happy to own dashboarding/alerts for these. Will create a durability dashboard and an alert for span drop rate > 0.5% over 10m. Also will add a weekly recurring health check reminder.
ops-bot: Reminder: attach estimated effort and acceptance criteria to each action item so we can track in the remediation board :clipboard:
adrian: Plan for span-loss: reproduce in staging on 100K trace sample, validate sampling config + envoy filters. Effort 2d, acceptance: no more than 0.1% loss in staging and a runbook entry.
sam: Aggregation fix: add deterministic grouping key + fix late-arrival windowing. Effort 3d (incl tests), acceptance: test harness reproduces previous bad aggregation and now matches expected counts.
lee: ETL lag changes: add per-source backpressure, cap parallelism, and fix a bug in the dedupe shard that stalls tasks. Effort 2-3d. Need to coordinate cutover with infra Monday 10:00 PT.
tara: Dashboards: will add token-level and route-level sampling metrics, span completeness, and a daily report. ETA Tue.
maya: Thanks. Let's lock owners: @adrian spans (EOD Thu investigation + remediation plan), @sam aggregation PR by Mon, @lee ETL cap + rollout next Mon, @tara dashboards by Tue. Can we get these items entered into the remediation board with owners + due dates?
adrian: Entering now. I'll include staging test steps.
sam: Added my PR link and tests to the board.
lee: Added rollout plan and scheduled infra blackout window. pinging infra for signoff.
tara: Dashboards created, shared link: https://grafana.redwood/ d/abcd123/observability-summary. Set alert for span drop.
maya: One more: recurring incident pattern — span losses occur more during traffic bursts. @adrian can you check whether prefix cache warmup or eviction correlates?
adrian: Good point. Will add traces of cache hits vs span drop and report back.
ops-bot: Action items logged: #4721 span-loss, #4722 aggregation-fix, #4723 etl-lag, #4724 dashboards. Owners assigned.
maya: Great. Let's have a short sync Fri 9am PT to confirm progress. :calendar:
sam: 9am PT works for me.
lee: added to calendar.
adrian: will be there.
tara: me too.
maya: If any blockers hit, flag in this thread and add to the runbook. Thanks all.
